module: Flowgraph node "Get Crawl Start Transform" (category repeat_instant, crawl). Gives the start position (startPosition, vec3) and rotation (startRotation, quat) of the active crawl via bridge.getCrawlSpawnTransform. Without an active crawl: node error and values {0,0,0} and {0,0,0,1}.

work.desc: Reads the spawn transform and converts it to tables.
